policy: Run each preregistered single-rank full-atlas shard with the same 55-second wall-clock execution window used in H11. If a rank times out with no result, repeat the identical full-atlas shard once. Only ranks with two such timeouts may be moved to a separately frozen exact sufficient-certificate protocol. No mathematical outcome from a timed-out run is counted.
no_changes: No rank, prediction, support, witness, interval, tolerance, or scientific adjudication changes are permitted.
